description: This file defines the ScreenCache class, which manages caching of widget outputs for screens in the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to get, put, and remove cached widget outputs based on screen name and widget context keys.

classes.name: ScreenCache
classes.description: A cache management class for storing and retrieving widget outputs associated with screens in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: ScreenCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with the type 'screen'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the cached widget output for a given screen name and widget context key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a widget output in the cache under a specified screen name and widget context key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached widget output based on screen name and widget context key, with optional verbose debugging logs.
